comments.comment: I have always been prochoice for this reason but I don't think I realised how few people thought the same way. When my dad was dying, the doctor came to explain it to me and he framed it as putting him on a breathing tube would keep him alive but it wouldn't help him. So the choice was to do it or not do it and let Dad go. I immediately agreed to letting go. Not because I didn't love my dad but because I didn't/don't believe in forcing him to suffer for my feelings. You know what was best for your baby boy. Letting him go was the best choice for him.❤️
